strings.O Taskbar Hero Optimizer (TBH Optimizer): Taskbar Hero Optimizer (TBH Optimizer) is a free, open-source tool built to optimize Gold gains, Experience (XP) and Chest management in the idle game Taskbar Hero. It analyzes the game's save file in real time to calculate exact efficiency stats for each stage.
strings.O arquivo de save padrão do jogo é monit: The game's default save file is monitored automatically by the app on Windows. It's located in the folder %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\TesseractStudio\TaskbarHero\SaveFile_Live.es3. The app reads this file on every real-time update, without modifying its data.
strings.Os baús de Taskbar Hero são itens do Ste: Taskbar Hero chests are Steam Inventory Service items with cooldowns validated on Steam's server. The monitor reads this data directly from the local Steam cache (inventorymsgcache). Common chests (gray) have an 11-minute cooldown (limit of 3 drops per 33 min), while stage boss chests (blue) have a 9-minute cooldown (limit of 3 drops per 27 min).
strings.Sim! Deixar o inventário de baús comuns: Yes! Keeping your common chest inventory full stops the game from sending common drop requests to Steam's servers. This prevents you from spending your Steam Daily Drop Limit on lower-value chests, letting all of your daily drop requests be directed exclusively to the valuable boss (blue) chests.
strings.Sim, é 100% segura. O otimizador opera e: Yes, it's 100% safe. The optimizer operates strictly in read-only mode, analyzing the save and the local cache without altering the game's memory, without injecting code and without modifying save files. The source code is fully open and auditable on GitHub.

guide.html.Qual é a melhor fase para farmar ouro no: What is the best stage to farm gold in Taskbar Hero?
guide.html.Não é a fase mais alta, e sim a de maior: It's not the highest stage, but the one with the highest Gold/hour, which depends on your clear time. A lower-reward stage you clear in 8 seconds yields more per hour than a higher-reward one that takes 18 seconds. The best stage changes according to your heroes, runes and gear.
guide.html.Por que ganho pouco XP farmando em fases: Why do I gain so little XP farming low stages?
guide.html.O XP é dividido apenas entre os heróis q: XP is split only among the heroes that survive until the end of the stage, and farming stages far below your level applies a heavy XP penalty. The ideal is the stage where you're strong enough to avoid the penalty, but fast enough to not lose any heroes.
guide.html.Qual a diferença entre Ouro Bruto e Ouro: What's the difference between Raw Gold and Adjusted Gold?
guide.html.Ouro Bruto é só o ouro de monstros e do: Raw Gold is just the gold from monsters and the stage's final chest. Adjusted Gold adds to that the market sell value of the dropped items — that's why stages that drop rare items climb the Adjusted Gold ranking.

guide.html.A ilusão da fase mais alta: The illusion of the highest stage
guide.html.O erro mais comum no Taskbar Hero é assu: The most common mistake in Taskbar Hero is to assume the highest stage you've reached is always the best to farm. The game's math doesn't work that way.
guide.html.O ganho de <strong>Ouro por Hora</strong: Your Gold per Hour and XP per Hour gains don't depend only on the stage's base reward value, but on the Clear Speed (Clear Time). If it takes you 3 minutes to clear a more advanced stage, but you clear an earlier stage in just 2 minutes, your Gold per Hour on the earlier stage can be considerably higher, even with a lower base reward.
guide.html.<strong>A regra de ouro:</strong> A melh: The golden rule: The best stage to farm changes constantly according to your heroes' stats, your rune multipliers and your current gear.
guide.html.Existem dois tipos principais de foco de: There are two main focuses for gold farming:
guide.html.<strong>Ouro Bruto:</strong> É a quantid: Raw Gold: The maximum amount of gold you can extract from the stage, focusing on the gold dropped by monsters and by the stage's final chest.
guide.html.<strong>Ouro Ajustado (Drop Selling):</s: Adjusted Gold (Drop Selling): The raw gold plus the market sell value of the items that drop from that stage. Stages that drop higher-rarity items climb the Adjusted Gold ranking, even when the raw gold is similar — that's why it's worth comparing both columns.
guide.html.O farm de XP é crucial para destravar as: XP farming is crucial for unlocking the skill trees. Unlike gold, XP is split among the living heroes. Stages that kill your weaker heroes reduce overall XP efficiency, since dead heroes don't receive the final reward. But be careful: farming stages far below your level applies a severe XP penalty.
guide.html.A fase ideal para XP geralmente é aquela: The ideal stage for XP is usually the one where you hit the perfect balance: strong enough to avoid the level penalty, but weak enough to guarantee fast kills with no deaths in your party.
guide.html.Chega de adivinhar. Calcule com exatidão: No more guessing. Calculate with precision.
guide.html.Nosso aplicativo gratuito lê o seu arqui: Our free app reads your save file in real time and calculates exactly the Gold/h and XP/h of each stage based on your current Clear Time.
guide.html.Deixe o jogo rodando na fase 1-1 por pel: Let the game run on stage 1-1 for at least 3 full runs to calibrate your computer's minimum time.
guide.html.Suba para as fases normais mais altas qu: Move up to the highest normal stages you clear quickly (such as 1-9, 2-9, 3-9). End-of-Act Boss stages (x-10) aren't good for Raw Gold and only serve for farming chests.
guide.html.Deixe rodar por alguns minutos em cada u: Let it run for a few minutes on each one.
guide.html.Abra a aba de Ouro ou XP no Otimizador e: Open the Gold or XP tab in the Optimizer and sort by the "/h" column. The stage at the top is your current answer.
guide.html.Lembre-se de refazer esse teste a cada g: Remember to redo this test after every major Weapon upgrade or new Hero unlock.

tutorial.html.O otimizador possui um menu lateral com: The optimizer has a side menu with several tabs. From the left you navigate between Dashboard, Stages, Advisor, Heroes, Inventory, Runes, Pets, Chests, Items and Materials. Here's how to interpret the data in each one:
tutorial.html.A tela inicial compila seus \"Clear Time: The home screen compiles your "Clear Times" (stage clear times). The magic happens in the table's last two columns:

tutorial.html.Lista mochila, armazém e banca, e resume: Lists your backpack, warehouse and stash, and summarizes what can be fused (synthesis): the game fuses 9 items of the same type and grade to raise their rarity, and the tab flags which groups are already "fusible" (ignoring locked items). At the top you'll see the Cube Level with the EXP bar and the functions already unlocked.
tutorial.html.O XP não tem valor fixo, pois ele é divi: XP has no fixed value, since it's split only among the heroes that survive until the end of the stage. The Optimizer specifically tracks your XP/hour, taking into account the run time and whether anyone in your party has been dying.
tutorial.html.O Taskbar Hero usa o inventário da Steam: Taskbar Hero uses the Steam inventory, which has strict global cooldown times.
tutorial.html.<strong>Painel Superior:</strong> Mostra: Top Panel: Shows progress bars telling you when your next chest (common or boss) will be released by Steam. The timer counts down the minutes.
tutorial.html.<strong>Tabela de Fases:</strong> Indica: Stage Table: Shows precisely the percentage (%) chance of dropping a common chest or blue (boss) chest if Steam authorizes a drop.
tutorial.html.Catálogos dos multiplicadores ativos do: Catalogs of your game's active multipliers. Runes directly affect gold, XP and combat power; pets give passive bonuses. Useful for seeing at a glance what's boosting your farm.
It works like an encyclopedic catalog. You can filter the items you want to find, see their respective market values (in gold) and which stages have the best percentage chances of dropping them. The Materials tab does the same for soul stones and other crafting materials, which don't take up equipment slots.

chest-drops.html.Até a versão 1.00.11, o baú comum (cinza: Up to version 1.00.11, the common chest (gray) had a cooldown of about 11 minutes (max. 3 per 33-min window) and the stage boss chest (blue) about 9 minutes (max. 3 per 27-min window). Update 1.00.12 (Server Migration) reduced these minimum times and moved control to the game server; the new values are lower and were not officially disclosed. The legendary Act boss chest is a first-clear reward and has no cooldown.
chest-drops.html.Por que não estou ganhando baús apesar d: Why am I not getting chests despite the stage's drop rate?
chest-drops.html.Os baús são itens do Steam Inventory Ser: Chests are Steam Inventory Service items, not part of the local save. Even if the stage shows a drop rate, the Steam cooldown is what decides: until that chest type's timer hits zero, the drop is denied regardless of the rate.
chest-drops.html.Os cooldowns de baú comum e de chefe são: Are the common and boss chest cooldowns shared?
chest-drops.html.Não. Cada baú é um itemdef diferente no: No. Each chest is a different itemdef on Steam and has its own cooldown. That's why it's possible to receive a common chest and a boss chest at almost the same time.
chest-drops.html.Acumular baús comuns ajuda a dropar mais: Does hoarding common chests help drop more boss chests?
chest-drops.html.Sim, indiretamente. Encher os 3 slots de: Yes, indirectly. Filling the 3 common chest slots doesn't change the base rate, but it makes the game stop requesting common chests from Steam, preserving the account's daily drop limit for boss (blue) chests. Since boss chests use independent slots, they keep dropping normally.

chest-drops.html.Diferente de ouro e XP que são calculado: Unlike gold and XP, which are calculated and stored purely in your local save file, chests in Taskbar Hero are Steam Inventory items (Steam Inventory Service).
chest-drops.html.Isso significa que não importa a taxa de: This means that no matter the drop rate ("chestRate") the stage claims to have: what dictates whether you get a chest or not are the strict Cooldown and Daily Limit rules set on Valve's servers.
chest-drops.html.<strong>Atualização v1.00.12 (Server Mig: Update v1.00.12 (Server Migration): the patch reduced the minimum acquisition times for Common and Stage Boss chests and moved cooldown control to the game's own server (it's no longer just the Steam Inventory Service). The times below were the ones in effect up to v1.00.11; the new ones are lower and were not officially disclosed. That's why the optimizer now estimates the real cooldown by measuring your own drops instead of relying on the old values.
chest-drops.html.Cai em praticamente todas as fases norma: Drops on virtually every normal stage in the game (e.g. 1-1, 1-2, etc).
chest-drops.html.Cai ao derrotar chefes de fase (raridade: Drops when you defeat stage bosses (RARE rarity). The 9-minute cooldown applies to high-level boss chests (e.g. the Lv50 Boss of Nightmare 3-5). Note: the early boss chests have much longer cooldowns — some of 300 min (5 h) and the very first ones up to 3600 min (60 h).
chest-drops.html.Recompensa de <strong>primeira passagem<: A first-clear reward for each Act boss (e.g. 1-10, 2-10, 3-10). Since it's guaranteed the first time, it has no cooldown — but it also can't be farmed repeatedly.
chest-drops.html.<strong>A Estratégia Avançada (Acúmulo d:
The Advanced Strategy (Hoarding Common Chests):
Steam enforces a daily drop limit per account (Daily Drop Limit) for any game. If you let the common chests (gray) drop and open them, the game spends that quota every ~11 minutes on low-value items. The veterans' trick: keep the common chest slots full and don't open them. With the common slots maxed out, the game client itself stops requesting common chests from Steam (it checks the local capacity before rolling the drop), preserving your entire daily quota for the Boss Chests (blue), which use an independent row of slots. The result: almost all of your daily drop quota turns into blue chests. (Filling the common ones doesn't change the base rate, it only protects the daily quota.)

v1.00.12 note: with the server migration, the chests you own now go to the Mailbox and drop control became server-side. This hoarding technique needs to be re-verified in this version — it may have changed.
